falseSynonyms.zh: 朋友不等於 colleagues 朋友是私人社交關係；同事可以成為朋友，但工作關係本身不代表友誼。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A colleague may be a friend, but the two relationships are not the same.

falseSynonyms.zh: 同學不等於同事 classmates 一起上課；colleagues 一起工作或屬同一專業環境。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Classmates share a class; colleagues share a workplace or professional context.

falseSynonyms.zh: 僱主不等於 colleague employer 是僱用員工的個人或機構；colleague 是工作上的同輩或其他工作人士。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An employer employs workers; a colleague works alongside them.

falseSynonyms.zh: 僱員不一定是自己的 colleague employee 只說某人受僱；若不是和你一起工作，便不一定是你的 colleague。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An employee is defined by employment status, not by a relationship to you.

falseSynonyms.zh: 客戶不等於 colleague client 接受專業服務或購買服務；colleague 是工作關係中的同事／同業。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A client receives a service; a colleague works with or alongside you.

falseSynonyms.zh: 上司可以是 colleague，但不是同義詞 supervisor 強調管理／監督職責；colleague 不指定上下級關係。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A supervisor may be your colleague, but the word identifies a management role.

falseSynonyms.zh: 下屬不等於 colleague subordinate 強調職級低於另一人；colleague 通常避免突出上下級。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Subordinate describes hierarchy; colleague describes a work relationship.

falseSynonyms.zh: 相識的人不等於 colleague acquaintance 只表示認識但不熟的人，未必有任何工作關係。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An acquaintance is someone you know; a colleague is connected through work.
